subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word. 

That young woman has a __**tendency**__ to date men who are similar to her father.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Propensity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tendency"** means an inclination towards a particular characteristic or type of behavior. (प्रवृत्ति)

 
 
• **Example: **He has a tendency to overthink every decision.
 
 
 
• **"Propensity"** refers to a natural inclination or tendency to behave in a certain way. (प्रवृत्ति)
 
 
• **Example: **She has a propensity to be very organized and meticulous.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'tendency'** is **'propensity'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Propensity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Apathy **(उदासीनता): Lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern.

 
 
• **Example:** His apathy towards the project was evident in his lack of participation.
 
 
 
• **Inactivity **(निष्क्रियता): The state of being inactive or not engaging in any physical activity.
 
 
• **Example: **A period of prolonged inactivity can lead to health issues.
 
 
 
• **Indifference** (उदासीनता): Lack of interest, concern, or sympathy.
 
 
• **Example:** Her indifference towards the plight of others was shocking.
